content:
Karina (People Ops): Hey team — planning to take intermittent parental leave (expecting to take several 2–4 week blocks over ~6 months). Quick logistics q's: what paperwork do I need to submit, how does the company top-up interact with payroll cutoff, and what do managers need to do for coverage/on-call? 
Maria (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: File FMLA (if eligible) + our internal Leave Request form. Ideally submit 30 days before a planned block, otherwise ASAP. We'll need proof of birth/adoption (scan/photo). 
Jen (Payroll): Top-up payments (company pay bridge) are processed monthly. To make the next payroll cycle we need approval before the payroll cutoff (usually the 20th of the month). If you miss the cutoff we can do a retro adjustment next month. 
Karina: Thanks — what's the best email to send docs to? Do I attach to the form or email scans? 
Maria: Use the leave portal: https://redwoodinference.docs/leaves/intermittent — upload scans there. If portal not handy, email leaves@redwood.com and CC your manager. 
Andrew (Eng Manager): For coverage, let's plan a handoff doc + reduce my on-call load temporarily. Karina, can you list which services you own? 
Sam (Engineer): I can pick up your weekly rota for the first 2 blocks. Also recommend these quick notes in the handoff: service owners, playbooks, common pager runbook. Example snippet:
```
- Service: inference-router
- Runbook: /runbooks/inference-router.md
- Health checks: /health/route
- Contact: sam@redwood.com
```
Andrew: Also, if you want reduced hours (e.g., 60% for a month), we can do a phased return — check with People Ops for approval and update on schedule. 
Leah (People Ops): Adding checklist we use: 1) Submit FMLA/internal leave request 2) Upload proof 3) Manager confirms coverage plan 4) Set expected return/check-in cadence. Link: https://redwoodintranet/people-ops/parental-leave-checklist 
Jen: Payroll note: if any top-up is tax-advantaged it still flows as payroll; we need banking details if retro payment required. If you prefer a calendar example, cutoffs are: submit by 20th -> paid on last day of month. 
hr-bot: Automated reminder: Please complete the Leave Request form within 7 days of submitting initial notice to avoid delays. 
Karina: Perfect — I'll upload docs today, ping @Andrew a list of my services, and schedule a 1:1 with Maria to confirm dates. Thanks all! :heart:
